name: arya-balanced
notes: Audition variant of the user-approved custom-2, for stock pads. Less bass weight: about 2.8 dB less at 80-100 Hz, with the same midrange/treble filters. A leaner alternative, not a claim of reference neutrality. Raw device Q; the 100 Hz Q is adjusted to retain approximately the baseline bandwidth. All five arya audition presets use -11.5 dB preamp, 1.5 dB below custom-2; equal preamp is not perceptual loudness matching. Modeled headroom only; not acoustically verified or auditioned.
